rows.grounds: repeated for emphasis, expressing iterative recurrence
compound denoting the wealth or radiance of complete absorption
compound with enclitic ca; qualifies the splendor as perpetually arisen
one possessing direct recognition or experiential knowledge

items.question: How does repeated engagement culminate in abiding recognition endowed with ever-risen full absorption?
premises: Repeated engagement is indicated by the doubling of again.
Full absorption possesses a splendor that is ever-risen.
This ever-risen splendor of full absorption conditions direct recognition.
items.inference: Through repeated engagement one may become a direct knower established in the ever-risen splendor of full absorption.
uncertainties: The exact force of the genitive in nityoditāyāśca in relation to lakṣmyā admits slight syntactic ambiguity.
items.plain_english: Again and again, one may become a direct knower endowed with the ever-risen splendor of full absorption.
